import re
import sys

text = sys.stdin.read()
values = {}

pattern = re.compile(
    r"\b(a|b|c|d|TMP)\s*<-\s*"
    r"(?:\(\s*(a|b|c|d|TMP)\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*100|(\d+))"
)

for match in pattern.finditer(text):
    target, source, increment, literal = match.groups()
    if literal is not None:
        values[target] = int(literal)
    else:
        values[target] = (values[source] + int(increment)) % 100

print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in ("a", "b", "c", "d", "TMP")) + ";")
